title: Custom 404 Page
description: Added a custom 404 page that matches the site's design system, with support for both light and dark modes.

title: Back-to-Top Control
description: Added a back-to-top button that appears when the user scrolls down on long pages, providing a quick way to return to the top.

title: Dark Mode Toggle
description: Introduced a theme toggle in the site header allowing users to switch between light and dark modes, with the preference persisted in localStorage.

title: Footer
description: Added a site-wide footer displaying the current year and a link to the GitHub repository.
